proposal.question: **Adopt TERRY's written test of 'downward coupling' for the UNG card?** Logged only if the CPC 8-14 day outlook issued Thu 12/3 puts at least 2 of Philadelphia, New York, Pittsburgh AND at least 2 of Chicago, Detroit, Columbus inside a Below area; one read, that issue only; otherwise the spread is sold at the bid by the close 12/4. **A:** adopt as written · **B:** leave it to AEOLUS's judgement · **C:** change the test or drop the kill.

recommendation.reason: **Rec: A** (TERRY's and PROME's), because a written test beats an undefined phrase; the other two candidates fail worse. ⚠️ It tests whether cold is on the official map, not vortex physics. It would have said sell in 10 of 14 years. In all 4 pass years holding still lost to selling, $29 to $203 on 5 spreads, and it would have sold 2022 and 2024, two of the three best hold years. Selling 12/4 beat holding in 12 of 19 years, stylized marks, so it saves decay and gives up the tail the card was bought for. n = 14, p 0.011 unadjusted across several forms tried. It reads a forecast; nothing observes cold. Applies only if the spread fills; your Dec-24 call is not on this card.
